verdict.rationale: FFmpeg exposes public C library APIs (libavformat, libavfilter, libavdevice and others), documented with nightly Doxygen references, versioned docs and coding examples, so a programmatic consumer can drive it directly. Community reports say the libav API docs are hard to navigate and often outdated, and that the C API makes invalid states easy to represent. That limits the depth of the documented API rather than contradicting it. missing for 10: clear, up-to-date narrative API guides and tutorials beyond Doxygen; independent hands-on corroboration that the API is easy to drive; a machine-readable spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
